Initial jobless claims came in at 200,000 for the week ending November 7 up 9,000 from the prior week, the most since August. That ends a three-week run below 200,000, leaving the count at 18 weeks below that mark since 1969. The four-week average was unchanged at 195,250, the lowest since October 1969.
